g.text: TDH = Qsearch titer + Qsetup tsetup + nmeas tscore
Dürr–Høyer uses repeated BBHT/Grover search rounds.
In BBHT round r, a random depth jr is selected and jr Grover iterations are executed.
Note: titer is the physical time
Before each normal BBHT search attempt, the quantum search state is prepared:
tsetup is the physical time assigned to one setup.
After each BBHT search attempt, the candidate z' must be classically evaluated:
z' → L(z') → compare with current threshold.
The term counts ALL measured candidates
per-event physical costs differ: tsetup ≠ tscore.
